t: 拜占庭皇帝尼基弗鲁斯一世掠夺了保加利亚首都普利斯卡并夺取了可汗克鲁姆的金库。
te: Byzantine emperor Nikephoros I plunders the Bulgarian capital of Pliska and captures Khan Krum's treasury.
dz: 拜占庭皇帝尼基弗鲁斯一世掠夺了保加利亚首都普利斯卡并夺取了可汗克鲁姆的金库。
de: Byzantine emperor Nikephoros I plunders the Bulgarian capital of Pliska and captures Khan Krum's treasury.

t: 拜占庭皇帝尼克福罗斯 我被杀了 他的继承人斯陶拉基斯受了重伤.
te: Byzantine Emperor Nikephoros I is killed and his heir Staurakios is seriously wounded.
dz: 普利斯卡战役:拜占庭皇帝尼克福罗斯 我被杀了 他的继承人斯陶拉基斯受了重伤.
de: Battle of Pliska: Byzantine Emperor Nikephoros I is killed and his heir Staurakios is seriously wounded.

t: 迈克尔一世·兰加贝被宣布为拜占庭皇帝,迫使竞争对手斯陶拉基奥斯放弃其主张.
te: Michael I Rangabe is proclaimed as Byzantine Emperor, forcing the rival claimant Staurakios to abdicate his claim.
dz: 迈克尔一世·兰加贝被宣布为拜占庭皇帝,迫使竞争对手斯陶拉基奥斯放弃其主张.
de: Michael I Rangabe is proclaimed as Byzantine Emperor, forcing the rival claimant Staurakios to abdicate his claim.
